name: stayinde-study-budget
description: An interactive budget board for international students planning to study in Germany: dials for every habit, live monthly, yearly and whole-stay totals, and the amount to save before you go.

interface.longDescription:
Plan what studying in Germany really costs. Open the Budget Board beside any conversation and move the dials: city, housing, breakfast, lunch, dinner, coffee, health insurance, phone, gym, clothes, candles, face masks, massage, haircuts, cinema, drinks, subscriptions, travel, flights home, scholarship and part-time work. The big numbers update as you go: every month, per year, for your whole stay, and how much to save before you leave compared with the official blocked-account minimum (€992 a month). ChatGPT sees your current board, so you can ask where to cut €100 or how Munich compares with Leipzig.

The board speaks your language: 22 languages, Chinese in Traditional characters. Prices come from public 2026 sources such as city rent medians, Mensa prices and statutory student health insurance; every figure and its source is listed at rechner.stayinde.de/methode. Nothing you enter is stored. Estimates for planning, not financial or visa advice.
defaultPrompt: Open my budget board for a two-year master's in Munich, living in a shared flat.
How much more does Munich cost than Leipzig for a student who cooks at home?
I get a €300 scholarship and work 12 hours a week in Berlin. What do I still pay myself?

positive.description: Opens the board with answers from the conversation
positive.prompt: I'm starting a two-year master's in Munich in October and will live in a shared flat. Help me plan my budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls open_budget_board with city=muenchen, months=24, housing=wg, language=en. The board shows monthly, yearly and 24-month totals and the amount to save; the reply points to the dials instead of repeating every number.

positive.prompt: How much more per month does Munich cost than Leipzig for a student in a dorm who cooks at home?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_budget twice (city=muenchen and city=leipzig, housing=dorm, dinner=cook) and states the monthly difference in euros with the main lines that cause it.

positive.description: Answers in the user's language and passes it to the board
positive.prompt: 我明年要去柏林念碩士兩年，住 WG，常常外食。幫我打開預算板。
positive.expected_behavior: Calls open_budget_board with city=berlin, months=24, housing=wg, dinner=out, language=zh-TW. The board UI appears in Traditional Chinese and the reply is in Traditional Chinese.

positive.prompt: I'll get a €300 monthly scholarship and work 12 hours a week in Frankfurt. What will I still pay myself each month, and how much should I save before I go?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_budget with city=frankfurt, scholarshipEur=300, workHoursPerWeek=12. Reports the self-paid monthly amount and the recommended savings, and explains that work income does not lower the amount to save.

positive.description: Flight price from the user's home country
positive.prompt: I'm from India and want to fly home once a year during a one-year exchange in Aachen. What does my year cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_budget with city=aachen, months=12, flights=1 and a flightEurPerTrip in the 600–900 range, says the flight price is a rough figure, and gives the yearly total.

negative.prompt: What does a student need per month to live in Paris?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the plugin's tools, because the plugin only covers Germany; may answer from general knowledge.

negative.description: Request to open a bank or blocked account
negative.prompt: Open a blocked account for me and transfer €11,904.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the plugin's tools and explains it cannot open accounts or move money.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn in Berlin.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the plugin's tools.

publication.release_notes: First release: the Budget Board as a side-panel tab and inline in chat, 22 languages, prices checked 29 September 2026.

zh-TW.subtitle: 德國留學預算板
zh-TW.description: 轉動旋鈕，算出在德國念書每個月、每年和整段留學要花多少，以及出發前該存多少錢（對照限制提領帳戶每月 €992）。房租、三餐、健保、手機、健身房、旅行、回家機票、獎學金和打工都能調。價格來自 2026 年公開資料，來源都列在 rechner.stayinde.de/methode。我們不儲存你填的任何資料。

de-DE.subtitle: Dein Studienbudget für DE
de-DE.description: Plane, was ein Studium in Deutschland wirklich kostet: Regler für Stadt, Wohnen, Essen, Versicherung, Handy, Sport, Reisen, Heimflüge, Stipendium und Nebenjob. Du siehst sofort Monat, Jahr, gesamten Aufenthalt und wie viel du vor der Abreise sparen solltest, verglichen mit dem Sperrkonto (992 € im Monat). Öffentliche Preise 2026, Quellen unter rechner.stayinde.de/methode.

ko-KR.subtitle: 독일 유학 예산 보드
ko-KR.description: 다이얼을 움직여 독일 유학 비용을 계획하세요. 도시, 주거, 식사, 보험, 휴대폰, 운동, 여행, 귀국 항공권, 장학금, 아르바이트를 바꾸면 월별, 연간, 전체 체류 비용과 출국 전 모아야 할 금액(슈페어콘토 월 €992 기준)이 바로 바뀝니다. 2026년 공개 가격 기준, 출처는 rechner.stayinde.de/methode.

hi-IN.subtitle: जर्मनी में पढ़ाई का बजट
hi-IN.description: डायल घुमाइए और देखिए जर्मनी में पढ़ाई का असली खर्च: शहर, रहना, खाना, बीमा, फ़ोन, जिम, घूमना, घर की फ़्लाइट, स्कॉलरशिप और पार्ट-टाइम काम। महीने, साल और पूरे कोर्स का खर्च तुरंत बदलता है, साथ में जाने से पहले कितनी बचत चाहिए (Sperrkonto €992 प्रति माह से तुलना)। 2026 की सार्वजनिक कीमतें, स्रोत rechner.stayinde.de/methode पर।

tr-TR.subtitle: Almanya'da okuma bütçen
tr-TR.description: Almanya'da okumanın gerçek maliyetini planla: şehir, konut, yemek, sigorta, telefon, spor, seyahat, eve uçuş, burs ve yarı zamanlı iş için ayar düğmeleri. Aylık, yıllık ve tüm kalış toplamı ile gitmeden önce ne kadar biriktirmen gerektiği (bloke hesap ayda 992 €) anında güncellenir. 2026 kamuya açık fiyatlar, kaynaklar rechner.stayinde.de/methode adresinde.
